subject: Fix some unitialized fields in `client` struct (#1126)
reason: The change only initializes client->io_last_reply_block and client->io_last_bufpos in createClient. Every read of these fields happens exclusively in the I/O-thread write path (ioThreadWriteToClient -> _writeToClient/writevToClient), which can only run after trySendWriteToIOThreads has unconditionally assigned both fields (src/io_threads.c:399-404) and set io_write_state to CLIENT_PENDING_IO; postWriteToClient only resets them. The previously uninitialized values were therefore never read on any code path, so the fix has no observable behavior change — no reply, replication, persistence, or cr
